introText:
From Fashion, Product, Communication and our postgraduate programmes, this showcase is your chance to experience bold ideas, fresh perspectives and the future of design.
The Debrief exhibition features a vast range of design outcomes, including fashion garments and accessories, product design, outdoor equipment, print media and publications, graphic design, game design, photography, social media and web design, animation, film projects and more!
Please join us to view our creative journey and the explorative design processes embedded in our major projects. The exhibition showcases ideas to outcomes, while embracing optimism, joy, and the excitement of stepping into the next chapter of our design careers.
